title: Erwin Hymer Group North America, Inc.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS (1,855 affected)
summary: 1) THE SEAT SYSTEM SLIDE TRACKS DO NOT ALLOW THE SEATS TO SLIDE, AND THERE IS AN INCORRECT ANGLE OF THE UPPER TORSO SAFETY BELT CAUSED BY NON-CHRYSLER HARDWARE AT THE SHOULDER SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGES.

title: GRUMMAN CORP.: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (111 affected)
summary: THE HEATER HOSE ROUTING CAN INTERFERE WITH THE THROTTLE CONTROL SYSTEM.

title: Mazda North American Operations: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (109,305 affected)
summary: A HARDTOP HOIST ACCESSORY KIT WAS SOLD TO CUSTOMERS WHO HAVE THE MIATA WITH A HARDTOP. THE PLASTIC BUCKLES USED TO ADJUST STRAP TENSION CAN BREAK AFTER THE HARDTOP HAS BEEN SUSPENDED BY THE HOIST.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEMS (1,058 affected)
summary: THERE IS FUEL LEAKAGE AT THE FUEL TANK FILL AND/OR VENT PIPE EXTENSION SOLDER JOINTS.

title: Jayco, Inc.: LIGHTING:LIGHT AND COMMUNICATIONS:REFLECTIVE DEVIC (41 affected)
summary: THE STOP/TURN COMBINATION MODULE OF THE REAR LIGHT ASSEMBLY WAS INSTALLED AS A SINGLE FILAMENT LAMP DEVICE WHICH ONLY FUNCTIONS AS A STOP/TURN LAMP, AND DOES NOT PROVIDE TAIL LAMPS.

title: FRUEHAUF CORPORATION: WHEELS (84 affected)
summary: THE INNER WHEEL BEARING CONES WERE MISSING FROM THE WHEEL ASSEMBLIES. MISSING INNER BEARING CONES CAN CAUSE OIL SEAL DETERIORATION OR CAUSE OVERHEATED BRAKES BECAUSE THE BRAKE DRUM COULD REST ON THE BRAKE LINING.

title: General Motors, LLC: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:HOSE:FLUID (5,152 affected)
summary: THE POWER STEERING GEAR INLET HOSE ON THESE VEHICLES CAN FRACTURE, CAUSING POWER STEERING FLUID TO SPRAY FROM HOSE INTO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT.

title: Norcold Inc.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:REFRIGERATORS (190,496 affected)
summary: CORROSION MAY DEVELOP INSIDE THE ELECTRONIC EYEBROW CONNECTOR CONTACT POINTS, CREATING CONTACT RESISTANCE.

title: Ford Motor Company: WHEELS (192 affected)
AMERTEK, ININC.: WHEELS:DISC:SPIDER (118 affected)
summary: THE FRONT WHEEL DISC CRACKS AROUND THE BOLT HOLE CIRCLE.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: LIGHTING AND COMMUNICATIONS SYSTEMS (149 affected)
summary: THE TAIL LIGHT LENSES DO NOT HAVE A REFLECTIVE SURFACE.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: BRAKES:MECHANICAL SERVICE:MOTORCYCLES ONLY (4,272 affected)
summary: SCREWS (PART NUMBER 3655) USED TO MOUNT THE FRONT WHEEL BRAKE DISC, THE JIFFY STAND SPRING, AND FRONT WHEEL CAP, DO NOT MEET HARLEY- DAVIDSON'S STRENGTH REQUIREMENTS AND MAY BREAK DURING VEHICLE OPERATION.

title: AMERTEK, ININC.: STEERING:POWER ASSIST (118 affected)
summary: A CONTAMINANT FROM IMPURITIES IN THE HYDRAULIC RETURN HOSES OR THE OIL RESERVOIR CAN LEAD TO MALFUNCTIONS OF THE PRESSURE CONTROL VALVES CONTROLLING THE POWER STEERING AND WATER PUMP ENGAGEMENT.

title: COLEMAN CO., INC.: STRUCTURE:BODY:WHEEL WELL (351 affected)
summary: THE WHEEL WELL WAS NOT RECESSED DEEPLY ENOUGH TO ALLOW ADEQUATE CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE TIRE SIDEWALL AND WHEEL WELL.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS (2,890 affected)
summary: THE LINK LEVER TRUNION ON THE SAFETY BELT RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING INSTALLATION.

title: KELLY SPRINGFIELD TIRE CO: TIRES:SIDEWALL (2,127 affected)
summary: AN IMPRESSION MADE BY A BENT SERIAL NUMBER TIN INTO THE SIDEWALL OF THE TIRE AT THE LEFT EDGE OF THE SERIAL INDENTIFICATION NUMBER DAMAGED THE SIDEWALL.

title: TRAILMASTER INC.: STEERING:LINKAGES (3,912 affected)
summary: THE CAST IRON STEERING CONTROL ARMS CAN CRACK AND BREAK DUE TO HIGH STRESS LOADING.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST (216 affected)
summary: THE STAINLESS STEEL FASTENERS FOR THE CAB ENTRY STEPS AND GRAB HANDLES CAN CRACK AND BREAK.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEMS (66,046 affected)
summary: THE FUEL INLET NEEDLE DOES NOT SEAL PROPERLY AGAINST THE FUEL INLET SEAT.
